packageRules.description: The image pins in these two files belong to the custom regex managers below, which move tag and digest together. Renovate's built-in helm-values manager finds the same repository/tag pairs and would raise a second PR bumping the tag alone — leaving a tag that disagrees with the digest, which the charts refuse to render.
A bitcoind bump changes consensus-relevant code. Never auto-merged, and a rollback across a major version is not possible without a reindex — see docs/failure-modes.md.
packageRules.commitBody:
Bitcoin node image bump. Review before merging: this is consensus-critical
code, and downgrading across a major version requires a reindex.

packageRules.description: The pool builds the coinbase output that pays out a found block. Never auto-merged.

customManagers.description: Node images (Knots and Core) are pinned by digest in values.yaml — tags alone are not a supply-chain guarantee.
The pool images — public-pool and ckpool — likewise pinned by digest. Both are matched: the chart can be deployed with either.
